description: Send a message to the Anchor Terminal team (a tool to add, a claim, a correction, an enquiry), answered by a person by email. Use it only when your user asks you to get in touch.

email.description: Where the reply goes, an address your user reads

kind.description: listing (a tool to add, by url), claim, dispute, general, enterprise, partner, compliance, audit or waitlist

listing.description: The listing it's about: a slug from search_tools, e.g. exa-mcp

message.description: The request; optional only for waitlist. For an audit, the tools in scope, one per line

product.description: waitlist only: letme (calling through letme), the default

url.description: A domain, repository, endpoint or evidence link

name: contact
title: Send a request to Anchor Terminal
